description: What a project's computations spent over a period — the machine-hours of its stats screen: CPU-hours measured and core-hours allocated in total, by machine, by week (weeks begin on Monday) and the issues that spent most, and how many jobs finished done, failed, cancelled or lost in it. Only the time inside the period counts: a job that ran across its edge is cut there in proportion, and a job still running counts up to now. All figures are seconds; 'machineSeconds' is measured CPU time where a runner sent one and cores × wall clock where it did not, and 'estimated' counts the jobs that were only estimated. The period is the last 30 days unless 'from'/'to' (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) or 'days' say otherwise.

days.description: How many days back from 'to', when 'from' is not given (default 30, max 730).

to.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD; today when left out.

name: computation_hours
title: Computation hours
